text:
nora: Quick brain dump we keep scattering admission/contiguous estimates across allocator, prefetcher, and the RDMA path. proposal: a light-weight ResidencyManager service that is the canonical source of truth for contiguous estimates, reservation leases, and tenant residency events.
ev an: spelling out responsibilities would help. what does ResidencyManager own vs local caches? :thinking_face:

nora: ownership sketch:
- canonical contiguous_estimate per-arena + versioned lease map
- reservation API: Reserve(token), Commit(token), Cancel(token)
- eviction/evict-record API where evictors post EvictObserved events
- admission decisions can be delegated but must consult RM for contig_est and reservation grants

peter: how do we avoid rpc hot-path cost? runtime/allocator need microsecond decisions.

lia: idea: keep a small LRU local cache with event stream incremental updates. RM authoritatively issues sequence numbers; local caches subscribe to updates and can serve stale reads for <50ms with a tunable staleness bound.

evan: event-sourcing angle: make every reservation + eviction an append-only event (ReservationCreated/Committed/Cancelled, EvictObserved). downstream jobs (billing, reconciler) subscribe and compute derived views. gives audit trail and simplifies reconciliation.

nora: exactly. benefits: billing uses ReservationCommitted events only, so we avoid overbilling from speculative reserves; reconciler can replay events to find lost evicts.

peter: safety/consistency: what about races? two nodes try to Reserve overlapping runs at same time.

lia: RM should offer conditional reservation: Reserve(request_id, tenant, arena, size, min_contig, ts_hint) -> {granted:bool, token, seq}. It atomically checks current free bitmap and either grants or returns best-effort suggestion. Under the hood RM takes a brief arena-level optimistic lock or uses CRDT-style compare-and-append.

evan: failure modes: RM outage must not kill requests. plan: local fallback admission uses local cache with degraded rules (lower thresholds) and emits a degraded-mode metric. also a short-circuit token that marks allocations as "best-effort" so later reconciliation can compensate.

nora: API sketch:
```
// fast path (local cache)
LocalCache.ContigEstimate(arena) -> size_bytes, seq

// authoritative
RM.Reserve(request_id, tenant, arena, size, min_contig_ms) -> {granted, token, seq}
RM.Commit(token) -> {ok, seq}
RM.Cancel(token) -> {ok, seq}
RM.RecordEvict(evict_id, tenant, arena, addr, size) -> ack
RM.Query(tenant, from_seq, to_seq) -> events[]
```

peter: telemetry / schema: every event contains schema_version, model_profile_version(for decisions that depend on recompute), and a trace_id. include tenant_quota_version so reconciler can reason about billing policy changes.

lia: performance micro-optimizations:
- RM returns a small signed grant token with (tenant, arena, token_id, seq); runtime can attach token to pinned pages so later evicters can attribute evicts without rpc
- prefetcher uses soft_reserve tokens that are cheaper (no registration) and expire automatically
- use partitioned RM instances keyed by arena-range to avoid global contention

evan: testing and correctness:
- simulate split-brain and ensure idempotent commit/cancel
- crash-recovery: events persisted to WAL and checkpointed into compacted snapshots for fast boot
- reconciliation job that matches EvictObserved vs Commit events and surfaces diffs per-tenant

nora: operational controls:
- degraded-mode thresholds
- per-tenant reservation caps
- feature-flag RM enforcement vs advisory mode
- alerting: contig_cache_miss_rate, rm_degraded_mode_ratio, reservation_conflict_rate

peter: long-term: extend RM to expose predictive guides (expected pin latency, recommended prefetch lease_ms) so runtime can make recompute vs pin decisions without duplicating logic.

lia: one more: security/tenancy: RM must validate tokens and sign grants; cross-tenant leaks would be bad. include HMAC-signed tokens and short TTL.

evan: billing reconciliation: reconciler should emit adjustments when commit vs actual_evicted_bytes differ > threshold. alert paging for tenants with repeated >10% delta.

nora: next steps:
- I'll write an RFC with API + event schema + HA design
- evan: prototype event format + reconciler (sandbox)
- peter: local-cache implementation sketch inside runtime and perf microbench
- lia: telemetry + alert set

meta-bot: created RFC draft: /docs/rfcs/residency-manager.md (id: rfc-20240712-01)

nora: thanks all. aim to land advisory-mode before full enforcement. will attach a small simulator to the RFC to exercise race cases. :thumbsup:
